title: 97% Of One Bat Species Vanished From Fungus
hook: A fungus erased 97% of northern long-eared bats.
closing: Losing bats removes free pest control, pushing more costs onto farms and food.
question: Have you seen fewer bats?

segments.say: Bat fungus reached 35 states by 2025. A cave outbreak became a continent-scale threat.
Northern long-eared bats declined 97 percent. A familiar night animal nearly vanished before most people noticed.
Bats provide up to 53 billion dollars in pest control. Their disappearance can raise farming costs.
